sn2.7:1.1: Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho Pañcālacaṇḍo devaputto Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn2.7:2.1: Sambādhe vata okāsaṃ || avindi bhūrimedhaso || yo jhānam abuddhi buddho || patilīnanisabho munīti || ||
sn2.7:3.1: Sambādhe vāpi vindanti || (Pañcālacaṇḍāti Bhagavā) || dhammaṃ nibbānapattiyā || ye satiṃ paccalatthaṃsu || sammā te susamāhitā ti || ||
